description: This file defines a static class 'ImageHelper' that provides utility methods for loading various types of images and PDFs from file paths, encapsulating common resource retrieval logic in a PDF manipulation library.

classes.name: ImageHelper
classes.description: A static utility class that provides methods for retrieving images and PDF resources from the filesystem, supporting multiple image formats and PDF forms.

methods.name: GetBmpImage
methods.description: Returns a XImage object for a specified BMP image.

methods.name: GetGifImage
methods.description: Returns a XImage object for a specified GIF image.

methods.name: GetJpegImage
methods.description: Returns a XImage object for a specified JPEG image.

methods.name: GetPngImage
methods.description: Returns a XImage object for a specified PNG image.

methods.name: GetTiffImage
methods.description: Returns a XImage object for a specified TIFF image.

methods.name: GetPdfFile
methods.description: Returns a PdfDocument object for a specified PDF file.

methods.name: GetPdfForm
methods.description: Returns an XPdfForm object for a specified PDF form.
